name: Home Robots
description: Issues commands to household machines — a Segway Navimow, a Matic vacuum, other supported vacuums and mowers, and Matter-compatible robots — through ordinary chat instructions. Each device has to be linked once before it will respond, so the setup work comes first and only listed hardware is covered.
